messages.author: 3f22b207863d2049
messages.subject: toy example contingency table sampling
parts:
Dear dev team and stan users,

Please see attached a toy example for sampling contingency tables with known row and column margins in Stan. The model requires a prior for the distribution of counts within each row (can be anything as long as it's a simplex). The model produces the estimated probability of observations being in a certain cell of the table. The application of this particular model was to redistribute the prevalence of anemia due to difference causes (the row totals) to three severity levels for which we know the total prevalence in the population (the column totals), and given expert priors about the severity distribution of anemia due to each cause (within row distribution).

Best,

Luc
